key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.44% significantly breaching the upper tolerance limit and food inflation surging to 11.51%, the risk of unanchoring inflation expectations is acute. Given the positive output gap of 0.60% and persistent supply-side shocks, a further tightening of 25 bps is essential to demonstrate our commitment to price stability and to ensure that inflation aligns with the 4% target.
